matrix_semantics: Language introduction is evidence/context, not strict per-target rejection or implemented support. baseline means present by PHP7.0.

features.title: File structure, PHP tags, inline HTML and blocks
features.lexical_requirements: HTML/PHP modes; open/close tags; close-tag newline and semicolon handling
features.notes: Default short_open_tag=false; <?= always recognized. BOM/text remain bytes, not stripped.

features.title: Names, variables, contextual and semi-reserved identifiers
features.lexical_requirements: Byte identifiers, case-insensitive ASCII keyword lookup; qualified names and contextual keywords
features.notes: Canonical qualified-name tokens and reference ampersand split are upstream conventions, not public token ABI.

features.title: Comments, no-ops, positions and spelling metadata
features.lexical_requirements: Retain whitespace/comments/doc comments; complete token indices
features.notes: Metadata checks apply to every node, not only fixtures requesting position dumps.

features.title: Lexical errors, grammar recovery and contextual diagnostics
features.lexical_requirements: Bad bytes, unterminated states, EOF and delimiter ownership
features.notes: Error cases in every family must also be covered. Generic LR error-production wording is not a public contract.

features.title: Numeric bases, overflow and floating-point values
features.lexical_requirements: Digits, prefixes, exponents; checked 64-bit integer and binary64 conversion
features.notes: Preserve raw spelling; numeric token kind can change on overflow.

features.title: Byte strings, interpolation and shell strings
features.notes: Decoded values and heredoc labels need not be UTF-8.

features.title: Unicode escape syntax in strings
features.lexical_requirements: Validate code-point escapes, encode resulting bytes
features.notes: Reject invalid code points per pinned reference; do not inherit a newer host tokenizer bug.

features.title: Negative offsets in simple string interpolation
Heredoc and nowdoc delimiters/newlines
features.lexical_requirements: Byte labels; line-sensitive endings and literal/interpolated modes

features.title: Flexible heredoc/nowdoc indentation and closing labels
Unary, binary, assignment, ternary and coalescing operators
features.lexical_requirements: Longest-match operators, references and contextual precedence
features.notes: Baseline includes PHP 7 spaceship/coalesce, exponentiation and compound assignments; coalesce-assignment is a 7.4 addition.

features.title: PHP 8 concatenation precedence; ternary language change
features.notes: Reference grammar gives ternary left precedence; do not silently promise PHP engine non-associativity checks absent upstream. Record that validation difference.

features.title: Scalar/object/array casts and historical spellings
features.notes: (unset) and (real) removed by PHP 8 language rules; nikic may retain them. Best-effort parser compatibility is distinct from engine validation.

features.title: Variables, variable variables and static members
Uniform variable syntax, calls and dereference chains
features.lexical_requirements: Contextual names after member operators; bracket/brace boundaries

features.title: Legacy curly-brace array/string offsets
features.lexical_requirements: Curly offset grammar only in PHP7 branch
features.notes: Deprecated in PHP 7.4; PHP8 grammar removes this alternative.

features.title: Arrays and list-pattern infrastructure
features.notes: Empty entries allowed in patterns, not ordinary arrays; preserve kind and holes.

features.title: Unpacking in array literals
features.notes: PHP 8.1 string-key unpacking is runtime semantics, not a new AST shape.

features.title: Call arguments, unpacking and reference forms
features.notes: Shared argument grammar also has deferred 8.6 placeholders; exclude those alternatives.

features.title: Named arguments
features.notes: PHP 8.1 permits named arguments after unpack; compiler-level ordering checks are not all parser requirements.

features.title: First-class callable ellipsis
features.lexical_requirements: Bare ... argument list versus unpack expression

features.title: Instantiation and ordinary clone expressions
features.lexical_requirements: new/clone tokens; anonymous class and argument boundaries
features.notes: Ordinary clone($x) is an expression; expanded clone call arguments belong to 8.5.

features.title: Dereference new expressions without surrounding parentheses
features.lexical_requirements: Postfix access after new constructor expression

features.title: Extended exit/die call syntax and stub names
features.notes: Keep reference Exit node for simple forms and FuncCall for extended forms.

features.title: Throw as an expression
features.notes: Standalone throw exists in baseline; expression placement is the version change.

features.title: Closures, capture lists and callable references
Yield, yield-from and generator binding
features.notes: yield predates PHP7; yield-from is PHP7.

features.title: Statements, declare, static/global variables, labels and unset
For, foreach, while and do loops
features.lexical_requirements: Loop keywords, AS and alternate end markers

features.title: Try/catch/finally structure
features.notes: Catch union added in 7.1; optional catch variable added in 8.0.

features.title: Functions, conditional declarations and parameters
features.notes: Includes PHP7 scalar and return type syntax; void parameter behavior follows target-sensitive built-in classification.

features.title: Trailing commas in parameters and closure captures
Named/built-in types and target-sensitive classification
features.notes: Builtin recognition can differ from strict language validity; null/false recognized from 8.0 even where standalone type validity arrived later.

features.title: Union types, mixed and static return types
Intersection types and never return type
DNF types and standalone null/false/true
features.lexical_requirements: Parenthesized intersections within unions; true type

features.title: Namespaces, imports, aliases and namespace normalization
Grouped namespace imports
features.lexical_requirements: Qualified prefix plus braced use items

features.title: Classes/interfaces/traits, modifiers and members
features.notes: Historical constructor names are ordinary methods; no runtime execution semantics.

features.title: Anonymous classes
features.lexical_requirements: new class and optional constructor arguments

features.title: Constants declared in traits
features.notes: Add a focused transition fixture if imported trait case does not exercise constants.

features.title: Final trait-method adaptation
features.notes: Add a focused transition fixture; broad trait case alone is not evidence of this subfeature.

features.title: Constructor property promotion
features.notes: Mixed fixture includes final promotion from PHP8.5; derive an in-scope variant in P02.

features.title: Unit/backed enums and enum cases
features.lexical_requirements: enum keyword, backing type and case

features.title: Attribute groups on in-scope declaration targets
Property hooks, abstract/final properties and hook bodies
features.lexical_requirements: get/set contextual names, hooks and modifiers
features.notes: Hooks also appear on promoted parameters; base grammar contains PHP8-only branches.

features.title: New expressions in permitted initializers
features.lexical_requirements: Existing new expression syntax in defaults
features.notes: Full constant-expression legality is a compiler/evaluator concern.

features.title: Arbitrary static variable initializers
features.lexical_requirements: Existing expression syntax after static default
features.notes: Add focused transition test; parser permissiveness does not prove runtime constant-expression legality.

features.title: __halt_compiler syntax, scope and raw tail
features.lexical_requirements: Validate halt syntax then retain terminal bytes

features.title: PHP 5.x target-specific interpretation
features.notes: Only explicit 5.x cases are deferred; their PHP7+ negative counterparts stay core.

features.title: Expanded clone call arguments and clone stub name
Experimental partial function application
features.lexical_requirements: ? argument placeholders; expanded bare ellipsis forms

features.title: AST common structures, bases and compatibility aliases
